content.short: SweetDAO's mission is to create a community-owned decentralized exchange that is open and accessible to all.
content.description:
SweetDAO's aim is to build the best self-sufficient decentralized exchange through protocol owned liquidity as well as having a token that is backed by assets. We are a community-run project, governed by the community where token holders can vote for all major changes to the protocol. Unlike other tokens we hope the value of the project's “SWEET” token comes from the utility and economic value collected by the protocol and its community. The value of the token will be broken down based on 3 main points all of which can be read more about in our whitepaper. Token backed by assets Service Fee collection Governance Token
